hints: Do the three experiments one at a time. Each time, look for the line number in what the robot says, then put the code back the way it was.
The number goes where the 0 is, on the telemetry line with the same name as the experiment. Keep the comma and the quote marks as they are.
The semicolon error and the spelling error name the lines you changed. The brace error names the line where the { it was closing opens, near the top.
